thread:
mira.design: quick sync - I prototyped a tiny 'cookbook' panel that surfaces 3 opinionated starter projects inline on first run. staging: https://staging.console.redwood-inference.com/onboard/cookbook-preview :mag:
lee_frontend: nice! quick glance: keyboard nav is mostly fine but opening a sample shifts layout and the focus lands on an unrelated button.
alex_pm: main KPI reminder: increase api-key creation and time-to-first-call. If cookbook boosts discovery that's great.
devon_devex: i'll add events: cookbook.view, cookbook.open_sample, cookbook.api_key_created. include variant and elapsed_ms.
sam_access: accessibility: ensure each sample has a clear accessible name, thumbnail alt text, and the open action is a proper button. Also avoid color-only state for the "recommended" badge.
lee_frontend: currently badges are pure CSS color. i'll add a text label and an icon. fix focus restore on close too.
qa-bot: QA found overlap on small widths where panel pushes main form off-screen. filing QA-501.
mira.design: copy for the panel header options: 'Quick starter cookbook', 'Starter projects', 'Cookbook: Try a sample'. Thoughts? keep short.
alex_pm: 'Starter projects' is clear.
sam_access: also add sr-only intro: 'Three quick projects to get your first inference running' for screen readers.
devon_devex: for the experiment we'll A/B test: inline cookbook vs compact CTA vs no-cookbook. track conversions and sample-open funnel. Split 40/30/30.
lee_frontend: implementation note: lazy-load sample manifests to avoid blocking initial paint; show skeletons. also will convert sample tiles to <button> with aria-pressed when selected.
mira.design: final: I'll update mocks with badge text and sr-only copy and push to design-assets. Please review PR for copy and a11y before merge. :thumbsup:
qa-bot: once fixes land, QA will rerun keyboard, focus restore, mobile layout checks.
alex_pm: plan looks good. aim to ship to staging Thu and start experiment Mon. thanks team!
